title: Terminated narrow-string assignment
summary: Recover 0x415b90 thiscall method: scan through first NUL, pass source and 32-bit byte length to external range assignment at 0x416520, and return its result. No direct destination field accesses. Original callers confirm ECX destination and one pointer stack argument.
test_description: 1539 direct original comparisons across capacities 15,16,31,63,127,255 and all lengths through capacity: external sources with high-bit bytes and trailing nonzero data, base self-alias, and terminator alias. Check exact delegation count/pointer/length, return pointer, full object and backing storage including untouched bytes and guards, source preservation, and FS head restoration. Test-only member dependency binds to accepted original range routine; memcpy import is controlled byte copy.
known_limits: Range assignment remains an external dependency; tests reuse accepted original helper rather than recovering its allocation or aliasing behavior.
Allocation/growth, interior aliases other than base, exceptions, invalid pointers, missing terminators and near-4GiB lengths are untested. Null source is not accepted by the original scan.
Layout and original thiscall are for 32-bit x86; no byte-matching claim.
